name: Compatibility Drift Check
openingVignette: A pressure seam opens across the route and makes every instrument disagree. The crew can cross it safely only by sharing clear station reports and refusing guesses that sound too certain.
gmSummary: Read-only compatibility fixture for builder/importer audit smoke. It must not create or update actors, items, chat, journals, sockets, scenes, tokens, compendia, or world data.

rounds.title: False Bearings
rounds.openingVignette: The seam bends sound and compass-light until the ship seems to have three headings at once.

stationCards.problem: The crew needs one clear command before the false bearings become panic.

skillApproaches.label: Steady the reports
skillApproaches.helpText: Ask each station for one confirmed fact and forbid speculation.

criticalSuccess.label: Clean Crossing
criticalSuccess.vignette: The seam falls behind and the crew's logs agree for once.

success.label: Safe Crossing
success.vignette: The ship clears the seam with its course intact.

mixed.label: Costly Crossing
mixed.vignette: The ship clears the seam, though the GM may mention lingering strain.

failure.label: Hard Crossing
failure.vignette: The ship escapes off course and under pressure, with no automatic effect applied.

criticalFailure.label: Marked Crossing
criticalFailure.vignette: The seam lets the ship go only after leaving a GM-reviewed future problem.
